route.detail: Isolated Raids are PvE only (green icon on the mission board). Learn maps and extractions there before Open Raids (blue). Reroll operative objectives for easier ones with the same payout; you start with 3 rerolls.

Alpha is free (10,000 credits, Shegolskoe access, more Shelter storage). For Beta, extract once each from Shegolskoe, Factory and Airport. Beta unlocks the Park investigation and a batch of cheap investigations.

Dam: Anomalous Waters first. Its "Rosin" Stockpile chain unlocks the Lock actuator board recipe, which opens electric doors with high-tier loot on Dam, Dogorsk and Park. Then Downtown: Return Address, Optics in the Dark and The Fisherman Who Didn't Return.

The Helix Vitalis studies (Distorted, Flowermen, Hellhounds, Invisibles, Turned Soldiers) are cheap and pair with monster kills you'll be doing anyway. Night Courier's SMG and Outer Perimeter add early weapons.

Extract 75 items and finish 10 successful raids. Gamma gives the M4A1 blueprint (the most recommended early unlock) and the Agent tier of operative objectives. Then grab Gigastructure: Entry Protocol and Reroll.

Kill 15 Invisibles and collect 100 Active Matter. Unlocks the Warlord body sleeve, Epicenter, and Fundamental Protocol cycle access. Buy the Keys fuse recipe here (300 tokens) to roll hangar, attic and crane keys. American Classics, Strength and Perception also open up.
Kill 20 Dendroids and 20 Flowermen, mostly in Park; bring fire. Unlocks Tier III chronogene synthesis, the Expert objective tier, the Thermal Drone and the AK-103.
Higher levels (Zeta to Mu) gate bigger investigations and gear, like the Large Magazine Rig at Theta. Mu grants permanent unlocks that carry into future timelines.

spending: Monolith Tokens come from raid objectives; the Baseline Compliance primary objective in Isolated Raids counts, so solo PvE progress works.
Pay tokens to bypass a Monolith objective only when you're stuck on it. Tokens spent on bypasses don't count toward the level's token total.
Spend CAM (Crystallised Active Matter) on Monolith Tokens: 500 CAM buys 5,000 tokens. Don't spend CAM on credits; credits are easy to earn.
Earn CAM from Priority Raids (purple maps on the board: 20 CAM per operative objective turned in, even if you die) and from Investigations.
Refine items for credits and chronotraces, Enriched (blue-tinted) items first.
Investigations can be done once per cycle and are the main source of Replicator blueprints, fusion recipes and Shelter upgrades.

600 Merits, Warlord body sleeve, Fundamental Protocol, Epicenter, Keys fuse recipe (300 tokens)

Higher investigations and gear; Mu gives permanent cross-timeline unlocks

reset.lost: Equipped chronogenes. Monolith access drops back to Alpha.
